query:
select
                purchases.id,
                purchases.product_id,
                purchases.activity_id,
                purchases.owner_id,
                owner.name as "owner_name?",
                purchases.for_resale as "price!",
                purchases.purchased_at,
                products.name as "product_name!: DIS"
            from purchases
            inner join products on products.id = purchases.product_id
            left join users owner on owner.id = purchases.owner_id
            where products.group_id = $1
            and purchases.for_resale is not null
            order by purchases.purchased_at
